title: PCR Plate Prep with 384 Well Plate
author: Opentrons
materials: Sample is added to these wells and mixed.

steps.title: Load plates and place controls
steps.instruction: Place up to four 384‑well plates on the deck. Add a no‑template control to well A1 and a human sample control to well B1 of each plate.

steps.title: Prepare mastermix with overage
steps.instruction: The protocol will prompt you to dispense the specified volume of each of the three mastermix reagents into the indicated number of tubes. Use the user‑defined Percent overage to calculate the extra volume, and set the P20 Single Channel pipette mount to GEN2. Mix the reagents for the user‑defined number of Mix repetitions before distribution.

steps.title: Distribute mastermix to plate
steps.instruction: Dispense the prepared mastermix into all wells that will later receive a sample, following the same well‑selection pattern that will be used for sample addition.

steps.title: Add samples to designated wells
steps.instruction: Transfer each sample (Number of samples: 1‑96) to the 384‑well plate, skipping wells down a column and skipping columns as illustrated (e.g., plate 1 to A1, C1, E1…H1, then A3, C3, E3…etc). After adding each sample, mix the well as required.

steps.title: Add positive control to final well
steps.instruction: Add the positive control reagent to the last well of the 384‑well plate after all samples have been placed.
